'''Corran Antillies My age old court deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 29 May 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5)|VS5O-47-Sudden_Impact.png|label=Sudden Impact (V)}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Vile Antillies DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Sudden Impact (V), Location, Location, Location (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Rodian (V), Greedo (V), IG-88 (V), Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

I've been working on this deck for ever and haven't posted it since V set 6 came out, so there may be some stuff it needs.

'Sudden impact V + Bubo, Sarlaac, and 3 shields': 3 shields under Sudden Impact (V), none named.

== Notes ==

* Bubo and Sarlacc are posted under Sudden Impact (V), outside the 60.
* 'Epp' ships dested the pilot-in-ship cards: Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Dengar In Punishing One, IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Epp 4lom/Bossk/Dengar' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, Bossk With Mortar Gun, Dengar With Blaster Carbine.
* Posted 'Sunsdown combo' dested Sunsdown & Too Cold For Speeders; 'It's worse combo' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Ghhk' Ghhhk (non-combo).
* Original-era (V) slips: Sudden Impact (VS5), Location x3 (VS5), Desilijic Tattoo (VS5), Rodian (VS3), Greedo (VS4), IG-88 (VS5), Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? x2 (VS3), Ability x3 (VS6). Krayt Dragon Bones and Reegesk unmarked, so printed.
* Original-era printing corrected: Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

Pretty standard Court deck.  If you’re playing a space oriented deck, start Mob points and pull Wakeelmui.  Then deploy one ship there per turn until you have a good enough force to attack.  Making sure that you don’t strand anyone there.  Also, deploy Search and destroy.  If playing a ground based deck, scum + first strike + AAA V= retrieving 4 force each time you initiate a battle.  Always try to have a bounty hunter at every site  so you can capture and feed the sarlaac (Pullable from under Sudden impact with Krayt Dragon bones V).  If your opponent doesn’t want to come after you, they’ll be losing force from your objective, Search (maybe), and force drains  enhanced by gailid, MJ’s saber, and presence.  All sites are pullable w/ LLL.  Pull Jabba’s palace 1st to pull Lower passages and pull the DB w/ the objective.  That’s about it.

*Switched out Wakelmui for Nal Hutta.  Will soon add influence V, Special Delivery V, Battle order, since I'll be holding space and ground sites, and 1 more twilek advisor, because I keep getting more and more effects.
